data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Topical antibacterials & antiseptics_

**Class:** Quaternary ammonium cationic detergent antiseptic

## Mechanism of action
- Disrupts microbial membranes; detergent cleansing action (removes crusts and debris)

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Wound cleansing (often with chlorhexidine — e.g. Savlon), seborrhoeic dermatitis/dandruff shampoos, cleansing crusted lesions

## Dose & formulations
- 0.5–1% solution for cleansing; rinse off

## Adverse effects
- Irritation and burns with strong solutions; contact dermatitis

## Contraindications
- Eyes and body cavities (strong solutions)

## Pregnancy & lactation
Safe for cleansing.

## Viva points
- Cationic detergent — inactivated by soap (anionic)

_Sources: Khopkar ch.30 (Cetrimide). Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
